atomicity.reason: One obligation: support pantograph opportunity charging.

parent_fit.reason: Pantograph charging is the means for topping up at terminal stops (US_OPPORTUNITY_CHARGING).

unambiguity.reason: SAE J3105 has distinct parts (J3105/1 infrastructure-mounted pantograph with roof rails, J3105/2 vehicle-mounted pantograph); 'roof-mounted pantograph' plus the bare standard number leaves the configuration open, and ARCH_CHG_INLET already reads it differently (contact rail).
unambiguity.suggestion: Name the J3105 part (e.g. J3105/1 or /2).

variant_consistency.reason: Gated var.charging.pantograph == True, same as US_OPPORTUNITY_CHARGING.

verifiability.reason: 'Support opportunity charging' has no success condition (power, contact time) beyond the standard reference.
verifiability.suggestion: Add the verified scope, e.g. power or energy per stop of a given duration.
